description: Source code for SSL client socket implementation and context management in the Chromium project, including functions for setting SSL key loggers, serializing protocols, and managing SSL configurations and certificates.

classes.name: SSLClientSocket
classes.description: Represents an SSL client socket with static methods for configuration and protocol serialization.

classes.name: SSLClientContext
classes.description: Manages SSL configurations, certificates, and session cache for SSL client connections.

methods.name: SSLClientSocket::SetSSLKeyLogger
methods.description: Sets the SSL key logger for SSL client sockets.

methods.name: SSLClientSocket::SerializeNextProtos
methods.description: Serializes a list of Next Protocols into a wire format for ALPN.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::CreateSSLClientSocket
methods.description: Creates a new SSL client socket with specified stream socket, host/port, and SSL config.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::GetClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves the client certificate and private key for a server.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::SetClientCertificate
methods.description: Sets the client certificate and private key for a server, and flushes session cache.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::ClearClientCertificate
methods.description: Removes the client certificate for a server and flushes session cache.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to SSL context events.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from SSL context events.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::OnSSLContextConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to SSL context configuration.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the certificate verifier.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the certificate database.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::NotifySSLConfigChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of SSL configuration changes.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::NotifySSLConfigForServerChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers when SSL configuration for a specific server changes.
